svg.title: How many delta-18-O samples each cave stands for
svg.text: 365 caves, and what the graph says about each
geolod:countD18OSamples of every geolod:Cave in the catalogue, ranked, on a logarithmic axis.
Caves, from the one with most samples to the one with fewest
365 caves, 447,170 samples in all, 10 at least. A geolod:Cave carries the count; the speleothems and their samples are separate nodes.
The counts are SISAL's own; the committed graph holds the catalogue, and the samples are in the large graph written by the pipeline.
